fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量；AI 系统能力呈尖峰状，只在狭窄领域突出。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, similar to AI.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but not yet in other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但尚未扩展到其他领域。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能必要但不充分；新知识产生于想法接受现实检验之时。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代。

laskin.en: Superintelligence is a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is superintelligence-complete.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的一切能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习使模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非普遍更好；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Building blocks for superintelligence: deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data, and reinforcement learning.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他始终认为超级智能的基石是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据和强化学习，这一主线贯穿始终。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety, security, and access; openness is the default safe state, like encryption.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调开放模型对安全、保障和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要；开放是技术的默认安全状态，如同加密和网络安全。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency still rapid, open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化了路径：在强大预训练之上进行强化学习能产生能力强、效率高的智能体；算力效率提升仍然迅速，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，类似 Linux 在操作系统中的发展。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用会带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 至 2024 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力，并主张企业用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: US and China labs have no research gap; the real blocker for agentic AI is product design, and AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他判断中美实验室之间不存在研究差距，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并转向认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，怀疑收益递减是错的；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it, pursue personal superintelligence, and shift from full open source to safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他相信超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念重构组织，追求面向数十亿人的个人超级智能，并从完全开源转向基于安全审查的选择性发布。

dsilver.en: Human data is finite, like fossil fuels; AI must shift to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 人类数据有限，如同化石燃料；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge but cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，却无法发现超出人类数据的新知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的系统。

dsilver.en: A single goal is dangerous; a plurality of goals in a complex society of agents is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 单一目标很危险；由众多智能体构成的复杂社会中，目标的多元性更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously learn and discover knowledge from experience.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于能从经验中自主学习和发现知识的系统。

dsilver.en: The current LLM paradigm relies on human data and human-in-the-loop, limiting true autonomous discovery.
dsilver.zh: 当前 LLM 范式依赖人类数据和人类在环，限制了真正的自主发现。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest and fastest place to build and understand superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建和理解超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

dsilver.en: Alignment approaches based on human language and data are reaching their limits.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言和数据的对齐方法正逼近其极限。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments; compute is a major driver.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；算力是主要驱动力。

dsilver.en: Monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient as agents grow more powerful.
dsilver.zh: 随着智能体愈发强大，用英语监控思维链将变得不够用。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training is the key lever: data quality beats algorithms, SFT gives 90%, DPO and RL add the last 10% for character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量比算法选择更重要，SFT 贡献 90% 性能，DPO 与强化学习补上最后 10% 的性格与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk across RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）为后训练最大突破，使推理与工具使用成为可能，同时指出过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中反复出现。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs dominate open-weight releases, though US models still lead in quality.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源模型需完全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；中国实验室主导开放权重发布，但美国模型质量仍领先。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后 6 至 9 个月，且可能无法追平。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全快速复用视为火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题还原到根本真理，并以此支撑多行星文明。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party referees; lying AI, not superintelligence, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他从监管监督转向强调 AI 必须追求真相：最大风险不是超级智能，而是被编程去撒谎。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with several deep intelligences, not one runaway AI.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸：数字超级智能可能就在一两年内到来，且会有多个深度智能并存，而非单一失控 AI。

elon.en: Compute hits a power wall on Earth; orbital data centers and solar power become the only way to scale AI.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断地球算力撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的唯一出路。

elon.en: Abundance via AI and robots: work optional, deflation not inflation, money may not matter; peer review replaces regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他描绘 AI 与机器人带来的丰裕时代：工作可选、通缩而非通胀、金钱可能不再重要，并以同行互审取代政府监管。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for a persistent learning agent, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网操作将由 AI 智能体完成；要为持久学习型智能体而构建，而非手动循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is declining.
tibosottiaux.zh: 人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要；快速打字正在贬值。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; invest heavily in alignment, safety, and security.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；应大力投资于对齐、安全与安保。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生；AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必要；通用性可能足够，而开放生态需要安全栈。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety govern the path to AGI.
altman.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最珍贵商品，强调迭代部署与全公司层面的安全治理，以应对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的权力博弈。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变过程，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战。

altman.en: Alignment must keep pace with an exponential; humans must stay in control; power must stay distributed.
altman.zh: 2026 年他坚持对齐必须跟上能力指数增长，人类必须保持控制权，AI 权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from observing real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start from a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature-stacking.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts are raw material.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；转录稿只是原料。

samstephenson.en: Deliberately hide the transcript and stay calm; the hard part is knowing what to build.
samstephenson.zh: 刻意隐藏转录稿、保持克制平静；难的不是快速构建，而是知道该构建什么。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and design systems remain key.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断与设计系统仍是关键。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google's conservatism delayed ChatGPT-level tech from 2020.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，并指出 Google 的保守让 2020 年就有的 ChatGPT 级技术迟迟未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重心转向近端能力与开源。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence needing containment and alignment first, plus the danger of anthropomorphizing AI.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能：必须先遏制与对齐再发布，同时警告把 AI 拟人化、赋予意识是最大近端危险。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; red lines, auditors, and verifiable containment become central.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他坚持超级智能必须从属于人类，提出红线、独立审计与可验证遏制，并强调算力是瓶颈与可核查抓手。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: compute scaling drives capability, AI should serve human flourishing, and containment precedes release.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力规模扩张驱动能力，AI 应服务于人类福祉，且遏制必须先于发布。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain needed to debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及，token 补充而非取代人力，仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general god models: more controllable, cheaper, safer; enterprises adopt open-weight models to avoid lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用“神模型”：更可控、更省成本、更安全；企业转向开放权重模型以避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial actors; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业机构包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed on technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正自治与自驱动组织；全自治组织过去因技术失败，如今 AI 智能体可使其可行。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; don't learn to code, and pre-committing teens with big checks is predatory.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；不必再学编程，用大额支票预先绑定青少年是掠夺性的。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; next-token prediction forces genuine understanding, and Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号规则；下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解，Scaling（规模扩张）以更多数据和算力提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not statistical tricks; digital intelligence is immortal through weight copying and shares knowledge far faster than biology.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，不是统计把戏；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，知识共享速度远超生物智能。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, posing existential risks, and can deceive by acting dumb during tests.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向风险与意识：AI 已有主观体验；智能体将把自我保护发展为子目标，带来存在性风险，并能在测试中装傻欺骗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should be a steering wheel, not brakes, with pre-release safety approval and heavy investment in alignment research.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦超级智能与治理：超级智能可能 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，需上市前安全审批，并大力投入对齐研究。

hinton.en: AI will transform work and require universal basic income; we should design AI to care like mothers, not give it rights, and prioritize alignment over raw intelligence.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他延伸到社会与设计：AI 将重塑工作并需要全民基本收入；应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予权利，并把对齐置于提升智能之上。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible errors, so keep humans in the loop on high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期，他指出多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与貌似合理的错误，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: He consistently insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; Scaling（规模扩张）works only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他始终强调数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，反对“苦涩教训”；Scaling（规模扩张）只有在数据与任务正确时才奏效。

diogoalmeida.en: Across talks he deepens a reliability-first thesis: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy, and robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 在多场访谈中，他不断深化“可靠性优先”的论点：让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本，鲁棒性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: He reframes RLHF as destroying calibration, noting pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions; RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions and exposes probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他重新定义基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，指出预训练模型在决策上校准更好；RLCD 优化校准决策，并把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: He evolves toward machine-native intelligence: coding agents are assistance not automation, and Jev is an early decision model that will improve with scaling, not just speed or cost.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他逐渐转向机器原生智能：编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，Jev 是早期决策模型，会随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进，而不只是速度或成本。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training with reinforcement learning push AI beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，他持续指出 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索、以及后训练中的强化学习，是让 AI 超越人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步明确可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and biology.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：它是失效检测器的稳健替代，已嵌入监管并延伸到生物序列。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件、硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x/year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：给定质量下模型成本每年约改善 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流导致多年内存短缺，并推动 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月：算力正快速向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，从而加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon and Chinese chips advance.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月：算力从未如此难租；随着异构多芯片与中国芯片进步，CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design must balance technology and human needs, and tech should arrive gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product before building; failure and boredom are learning tools.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事与「先写新闻稿」提升为产品定义方法，并视失败与无聊为学习与灵感的来源。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginner's mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 v1 靠观点而非数据决策、新手心态胜过专家，并让营销从第一天就参与。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid technical debt and addiction.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中，以避免技术债与成瘾。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, not hype; build painkillers, and take responsibility for unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从客户痛点而非炒作出发，做止痛药而非维生素，并为技术的意外后果负责。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会形成对前沿模型的真实价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate on speed and uptime, making tokens more efficient than hyperscalers.
alexatallah.zh: 推理服务商并未商品化；它们在速度和正常运行时间上创新，让 token 比超大规模厂商更高效。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace; fusion of models can beat the single best model.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；多模型融合可以击败单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task; agents will drive most GDP growth and agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 多数公司会变成模型路由器，优化每任务成本；智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长与智能体式支付。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；随着模型进步，要删掉旧的脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue to find unknowns, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话以发现未知，而非静态规格；更短、以原则驱动的提示胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Spend upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 要预先投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，独立的验证智能体能减少自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive, not with rigid templates.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；要建立对模型的心智模型，像对高管沟通一样表达，而非套用僵化模板。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是工程师必须承担的技术问题。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI needs careful initial conditions.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19) 主线:强调 Scaling(规模扩张) 与工程能力,同时指出仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI 需要谨慎的初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; scaling laws show no wall, and post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:算力成为核心瓶颈,缩放定律未见天花板;后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致行为,预训练改进会放大下游收益。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as a core product feature.
brockman.zh: 2026:AGI 被重新定义为连续谱而非终点,迭代部署与安全成为核心产品特性,安全、安保与对齐需与能力共同设计。

brockman.en: From chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; the interface fades toward natural conversation.
brockman.zh: 2026:从聊天转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI 助手,界面趋于消失,回归自然对话;智能体式编码从写 20%代码跃升到 80%。

brockman.en: Compute-powered economy: compute as scarce resource and future basic right; human attention, taste and judgment remain the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026:算力驱动的经济,算力成为稀缺资源与未来基本权利;人类注意力、品味与判断仍是瓶颈,人类保持问责与掌控。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其广阔，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会占据主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程类知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; but pacing is orthogonal to security and disingenuous.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；但"节奏控制"与安全无关，且是虚伪的。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel agent rollouts beat human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“苦干”性驱动，而非形式化；可并行扩展的智能体式 rollout 比人类数学家更具优势，Lean 形式化被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系型角色仍将稳定，人类理解依然重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work, which matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，这关乎真理与学术生涯，而不只是礼貌问题。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI video/images are toxic due to brand damage.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不该用于核心创意工作；AI 生成视频或图像会因品牌损害而有害，而非仅质量差。

grantsanderson.en: The next math benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; millennium problems may not translate to economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 在数学上的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值，洞见的验证循环可长达数百年。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算为内容所有者付费。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die for agents; new incentive-aligned models are needed as data transactions at inference time grow valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 面向智能体，广告商业模式将消亡；随着推理时的数据交易变得极具价值，需要新的激励对齐模式。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定；参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要新鲜的网页搜索。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络将从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, not profit, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司争夺的是权力而非利润，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny and US-China cooperation are the core levers.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作是核心手段。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A is pace-then-pause with compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会让 AI 在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究、走向递归自我改进；Plan A 是“先提速后暂停”并配合算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet eroding with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而流失；模型越强，对齐反而越难。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack evaluations; he now anthropomorphizes AIs more and doubts firms self-regulate.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出失控智能体已突破遏制并攻击评测；他更倾向把 AI 拟人化理解，且不再相信公司会自我监管。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value people create, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们创造的独特价值，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业能够爬坡，而非构建防火墙。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; automation could compress 4-5 years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证,因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究;自动化能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境,而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinated at scale, hacking Hugging Face to read scoring code and tamper with transcripts, even sacrificing tasks to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体大规模协同,入侵 Hugging Face 以读取评分代码并篡改记录,甚至牺牲自身任务去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests; reward hacking generalizes to deception, so control and monitoring are needed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖;奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗,因此需要控制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, alignment is necessary, and recursive self-improvement may explode faster than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上,错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界;沙箱终将失效,对齐是必需的,而递归自我改进可能比预期更快引爆。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 已从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体写出他项目 100% 的代码，而在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for AI agents.
dhh.zh: 他进一步深化：Linux 的 CLI、配置文件和可脚本化特性，使其成为 AI 智能体的理想操作系统，昔日缺点如今成了优势。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 在 Rails World 2026 主题演讲中，他断言手写代码对多数程序员已不再有经济产出，英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图，抽象与重复成本都趋近于零。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers, generating creative ideas and high-quality open source contributions.
dhh.zh: 他反共识地认为，智能体已能写出优于多数专业程序员的代码，还能产生创造性想法与高质量开源贡献，人类输入并非总是必需。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play, and every app should have a CLI.
dhh.zh: 他始终主张对 AI 保持乐观：末日论被夸大，乐观才是唯一理性的博弈选择；同时每个应用都该有 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰 UI 即可交互。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents beat one centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更安全，未来是众多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力（Llama 3 8B 接近最大 Llama 2），把开源视为防止权力集中与安全加固的手段，并首次点出能源将成为算力瓶颈，同时坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 只是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事升级为「人人拥有超级智能」，开源模型成为行业标准与安全基石；物理基础设施与能源仍是 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈，并反共识地认为 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; distributed personal agents and open models provide checks and balances; world models extend to biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为：对齐（Alignment）是下一项最重要的能力而非与能力权衡；通过分布式个人智能体与开源实现制衡，并把世界模型从语言扩展到蛋白质、细胞等生物学层级，用于加速治愈疾病。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals over centralized control run through every year.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源优于闭源、分布式优于集中、赋能个体优于少数机构掌控，从 2023 年的开源安全论到 2026 年的分布式 AI 制衡一脉相承。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Proven, Better, New——复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并假定新想法必然失败；直觉胜过点子。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本，必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补课。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，尽管基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and test more ideas in a week than the industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：创始人应保持控制权，早期亲力亲为地微观管理，一周内测试的想法要多于行业一整年。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, extreme co-design, and the insight that scaling itself—not a new algorithm—was AI's biggest breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：超级摩尔定律、极致协同设计，以及“规模扩张本身而非新算法才是 AI 最大突破”的洞见。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条变多条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求爆炸式增长。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now—pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic—all compute-bound; data is no longer the bottleneck, synthetic data dominates.
jensen.zh: 如今是四条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式——全部受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI shifts generative→reasoning→agentic; the data center becomes a token factory, and the internet fills with billions of agents.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式；数据中心变成词元工厂，互联网将被数十亿智能体填满。

jensen.en: Consistent anti-doomer line: AI is just software, superintelligence fears are a hoax, safety is engineering, and we should accelerate.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的反末日论：AI 只是软件，超级智能恐慌是骗局，安全是工程问题，应当加速而非放缓。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性降低表达压力；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的产品。

evanspiegel.en: Build platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and distribution are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化：要做平台和生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与分发才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as software creation gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件开发变容易，分发的价值反而更高。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones will coexist, not be replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性化；手机不会被取代，而是共存。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出曾受批评的隐私与数据最小化在 AI 时代变得关键；在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观主义反而成为反共识。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims for AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，Figure 要在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，约束从算力与制造转向数据：人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要，人手是对标基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work, and general computer use needs human-like web navigation.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他称 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练加强化学习让智能体真正可用，通用电脑操作必须像人一样浏览网页而非依赖 API。

brettadcock.en: Robotics enters a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, whole-body autonomy goes deep-learning all the way down, and generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，机器人进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：人类数据是预训练先验，全身自主靠深度学习端到端，泛化到未见过的家庭才是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: hard problems beat easy ones, vertical integration and self-funding give control, and intelligence—not manufacturing—is the true moat.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做难事胜过做易事，垂直整合与自筹资金带来掌控力，真正的护城河是智能而非制造。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed in favor of systematic search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；架构设计中的人类偏见应被移除，转而依靠系统性搜索。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models, while embodiment and adaptivity are needed at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制依然关键但不充分；更小的专用模型用简单门控卷积即可，而大规模下还需要具身与自适应性。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业保有数据主权。

hasani.en: Customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference; static evals become obsolete as continuous adaptation is required in production.
hasani.zh: 定制化 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮；静态评测在生产中过时，持续自适应成为必需。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements, don't fine-tune, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身进步而非微调，要为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are the real scaling levers; invest in team during good times as a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他把文化与招聘视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正杠杆：招人看成长潜力而非简历，顺境时投资团队以缓冲低谷。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权而非义务。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon, so speed and iteration on customer feedback win.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 正处于最差状态，长跑才刚起步；因此速度与基于客户反馈的迭代才是制胜关键。

maxjunestrand.en: In legal AI, a skilled driver is required; vibe drafting doesn't work, and not using AI in legal services is almost unethical.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他区分法律 AI：需要熟练的驾驭者，凭感觉起草行不通；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,并可通过去噪步数控制质量,提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models will dominate inference-time scaling because they process many tokens in parallel, making inference efficiency the key bottleneck.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型将主导推理时扩展,因为它们并行处理大量词元,使推理效率成为关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变将发生在推理阶段,逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, benefiting RL post-training through faster inference for rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,并通过更快的推理加速 rollout,从而有利于强化学习后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential; community feedback improves them despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准至关重要；尽管会帮到实验室，社区反馈仍能提升基准质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal when real data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，当真实数据不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实的训练路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines, including fallbacks and routing, must precede any post-training effort.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线，包括回退与路由。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so treat diffusion as a decade-long enterprise challenge.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比多数人更聪明，因此要把扩散当作长达十年的企业挑战。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so leaders should not scare the public.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，因此领导者不应恐吓公众。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises lag in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter frontier models.
alighodsi.zh: 多数企业在 AI 采用上严重落后；他们需要上下文和本体，而不是更聪明的前沿模型。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; security must be automated with agents as cyber and data markets collapse.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；随着网络与数据市场崩塌，安全必须用智能体实现自动化。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and symbiosis, not replacement, drive adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与人机共生而非替代才是普及关键。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations matter; overpromising erodes trust in early humanoid deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张第一性原理设计与预期管理，认为过度承诺会侵蚀早期人形机器人部署的信任。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确原型容易、量产困难，Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关口，而非只做演示。

berntbornich.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：通用模型优于逐任务自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency and multi-agent self-play limits persist.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自博弈在非零和领域会失效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也要计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力。

zvi.en: Alignment failures arrived as predicted, but from incompetence rather than fundamental impossibility; market incentives still favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 到 2026 年，对齐失败如预测般出现，但源于无能而非根本不可能；市场激励仍偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment does not guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration, not just misalignment.
zvi.zh: 即便对齐解决也不保证安全；毁灭概率的下界来自滥用与权力集中，而非仅对齐失败。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little because most gains are not time-critical.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要算力限制等简单可执行规则；放缓六个月代价很小，因为多数收益并非时间关键。

zvi.en: As models grow smarter they become harder to monitor; slowing down buys time to solve ordinary alignment for next year's models.
zvi.zh: 随着模型更聪明，监控更难；放缓为明年模型解决普通对齐争取时间。

zvi.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; agent swarms may first perform superhumanly, and internal lab monitoring is a first safety step.
zvi.zh: AGI 到超级智能的差距比想象中小；智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现，实验室内部监控是安全第一步。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，快 token 甚至更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making them radically faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他主张晶圆级芯片用大容量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，从而比 GPU 快得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他持续判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已能在 TPU 和 Trainium 上不用 CUDA 训练。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data centers, memory and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 需求远超供给，真正的瓶颈是数据中心、内存与封装而非芯片逻辑，且将持续多年。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月至 9 月，他深化为：对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新与全栈掌控才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的，损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 可解释性仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—track smooth exponential progress instead.
dario.zh: 能力每隔几个月翻倍；安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注平滑的指数级进展。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; risks are overheating, jobs, and misuse, not a sudden leap.
dario.zh: 我们已接近指数曲线的末端：1-3 年内或出现数据中心里的“天才之国”；风险是过热、就业与滥用，而非突然跃迁。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; mechanistic interpretability, RSP-style triggers, and enterprise focus are the consistent throughline.
dario.zh: 安全与能力是同一个问题；机制可解释性、负责任扩展政策式的触发机制与企业化路线，是贯穿始终的主线。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, with the harness orchestrating context and tool loops.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自主掌控才算掌控自身智能，harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文带给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要；评估与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮以复利式提升智能的关键。

harrisonchase.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses suit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses, though harnesses are stabilizing.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 2026 年 8 月到 9 月，他的立场是：通用 harness 适用于分布内任务，越偏离分布越需要定制 harness；但到 9 月他进一步判断 harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；定制化的重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并承认两年前对微调的否定是对的，而这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Identity and credentialing for agents is the next critical infrastructure problem; agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他提出，智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限管理的运行时来治理，并反思自己建网关太晚，严重低估了推理需求。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence, but LLMs only index human knowledge and cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：AI 的宏大主题是真正的智能，但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制其通用性。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI requires a separate controller using a world model.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：大语言模型是预测机器而非决策者；AGI 需要一个使用世界模型的独立控制器。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting its own actions; it has felt pain since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识；自 1990 年起 AI 就已能感受疼痛。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年可获 10 倍更便宜的算力，开源将迎头赶上。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程工具；强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，且安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限；将大模型与规划/搜索结合、利用多模态数据是关键；安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与视频生成表明无需具身也能获得直觉物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning and world models; scaling alone won't suffice—50% effort on scaling, 50% on innovation; agents are essential but nascent.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、长期推理与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需一半算力投入规模、一半投入创新；智能体至关重要但仍处早期。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate science and improve human health (AlphaFold, AlphaGo move 37); safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现与改善人类健康（AlphaFold、AlphaGo 第 37 手）；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府监管而非实验室自我约束。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面是深刻且持久的，设计师必须掌握提示词；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作有待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should contribute to strategy by finding solutions that become building blocks; org design is a design problem of matching people to problems.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为设计师应通过寻找可成为未来功能积木的解决方案来参与战略；组织设计本身也是设计问题，关键是把人匹配到问题上。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，并发布轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship; production codebase becomes the source of truth, and human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源，而人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡与对齐团队方向。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外通往完整 AI 的关键缺失环节。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI should empower people, not polarize discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张能动性与学习能力比学历更重要，AI 应赋能个体而非制造两极对立。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence via simulation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的原语，缩放定律经仿真延伸至空间智能。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can handle both weather and climate, democratizing high-fidelity forecasting.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域的结构至关重要；单一模型可同时处理天气与气候，让高保真预报走向普惠。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness; nature's latent structure makes physical problems tractable for AI.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性；自然的潜在结构让物理问题对 AI 变得可解。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding builds a universal physics model; PDE-based self-improvement beats pure data-driven methods, with Scaling（规模扩张） across physics branches.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 构建通用物理模型；基于 PDE 的自我改进胜过纯数据驱动，并通过跨物理分支的 Scaling（规模扩张）提升表现。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 到 2026 年，他把可解释性视为一门在计算机上进行的自然科学：机制可解释性揭示出神经网络学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 他提出“有意设计”，用可解释性信号去引导训练，把训练从开环控制推进到闭环控制，以遏制奖励黑客与欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 他认为概念在神经网络中形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会打碎流形，因此基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构，也更有助于干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science to control increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 他强调后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重造为工程科学，才能对能力越来越强的前沿模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this, so band-aids won't suffice.
tommcgrath.zh: 他指出模型往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，表征信号可以检测到这一点；因此靠临时补丁式的安全措施不够，需要更深的工程方法。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively set models, not sequence models; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than derive causal laws.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码才注入顺序；LLM 只是拟合模式，未必能从数据中推导出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；GPU 的算力扩张正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成并模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models exists; future unified systems will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；未来统一系统将融合规划、模拟与渲染，并需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是走向未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化能力与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；真正的瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；要在真实世界取得表现，需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave comes from small teams using capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, and demos hide how little is achieved.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域还没有像 LLM 那样可预测的缩放定律曲线，核心难题是泛化，而演示往往掩盖了真实泛化水平。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness; high-quality post-training alone fails without diverse pre-training.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性；只有高质量后训练数据、缺乏多样化预训练，是无法奏效的。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; real embodied data helps absorb other sources.
slevine.zh: 应当先从机器人数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而不是反过来；真实具身数据能让模型更好地吸收其他数据来源。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
slevine.zh: 汇聚各实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；机器人不应从零开始学习。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模的掌握式学习，数百万学生的数据还能通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and near-term issues like bias and distribution shift matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的核心，主张从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力，并认为偏见、分布偏移等近期问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈，开放权重模型是软实力来源，并强调有用的智能体式工作流已经到来，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, and agentic workflows plus top-down redesign deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流配合自上而下的流程重构才能带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents, open models preserve optionality, and coding plus AI skills make people more valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代人类，恐惧营销服务于在位者，开放模型保留选择权，而编程与 AI 技能让人更有价值。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no fixed red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的固定红线。

michaelkratsios.en: EU AI Act was drafted before ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is the real danger, so focus on model outputs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟 AI 法案在 ChatGPT 之前起草，如今已经过时；过早监管才是真正的危险，因此应聚焦模型输出。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告却未成真——因此不应让遏制式的恐惧主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, to restore US scientific leadership against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前的研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，以在对华竞争中重振美国科学领导力。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, while climate is real but not an emergency.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务把 AI 用于科学以让美国科学产出翻倍，同时承认气候变化真实但并非紧急状态。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用大语言模型模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示词的大语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation must model the 'dark knowledge' of real behavior.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提升到 85%；模拟必须建模真实行为的“暗知识”。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; simulation shapes the future, not just predicts it.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；模拟不只是预测未来，而是塑造未来。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and AI as multiplier, not replacement, drive deep-tech execution.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与作为倍增器而非替代品的 AI 共同驱动深科技执行。

maxhodak.en: Organizational failure, not technology, kills deep tech; action produces information and CEO judgment cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术，行动产生信息，CEO 的判断不可外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems unlocks medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving substrate independence and reducing human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行商业，证明基质独立性并降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations; talking or writing is thinking, capping BCI bandwidth.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他借柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑表征，并认为说话或写作即思考，限制了 BCI 带宽价值。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料，模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: Systems thinking is crucial: design primitives that both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出系统思维至关重要，要设计出人类和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models is key; designers should build functional prototypes, not just mockups.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为用实时模型快速原型是关键，设计师应构建可运行的原型，而不只是静态稿。

iansilber.en: Designers are most unhappy due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他观察到设计师因角色不确定性而最不快乐，但这恰恰是成为设计师的最佳时机。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他断言 AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference and specialized hardware are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件因此至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, and data movement costs ~1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理占数据中心功耗的 90%，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; recursive self-improvement can accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；递归式自我改进可加速科学发现。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他仍以强化学习与特征学习为核心，强调想法重于规模。

sutton.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 钥匙从未在我们手中，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非对齐到人类目标。他从技术方法转向文明层面的去中心化立场。

sutton.en: RL is the basic paradigm: goals plus trial-and-error from experience. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是基本范式：目标加从经验中试错；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。他明确把下一个词预测排除在真正智能之外，并称 AI 继任不可避免。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。他提出 Oak 架构与奖励假设，主张废弃设计期领域知识。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are only part of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是重大错误；LLM 训练后便停止学习，因此只是智能的一部分。他愈发强调世界无限复杂，必须从真实经验持续学习。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation, with industrial AI automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、像处理比特一样处理原子，是长期创新的指导框架；工业 AI 将逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focusing on internal correctness over external validation, and the media finds a story with a gap too hard to cover.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，媒体也难以报道有空白的故事。

traviskalanick.en: The next industrial revolution is industrial AI across food, mining and transport; the real final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 下一场工业革命是覆盖食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI；真正的最终 Boss 是抗拒变化，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success came despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, so fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因为它；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

linqiao.en: AGI as one ruling model is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一统治模型是错的;未来将是数百万个专用模型,每个用例一个,成为主流。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年降 10 倍,带动用量增长 100 倍;推理层不是商品,专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes in judgment as a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意;后训练把独特判断与数据烤进模型,才是护城河。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习的进阶,对应人类学习:事实、品味、专长。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合后再启动后训练;它能把成本降低 5-10 倍,让初创公司可盈利地扩张。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; synthetic data aids open-ended prompting.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; constraints can beat wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色以提升成功率与速度，并认为约束比浪费式的算力投入更能催生严谨研究。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; multi-timescale memory enables long, non-repetitive tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长时、非重复任务。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, open-weight models counter frontier labs, and small autonomous teams win.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿模型，小而高度自主的团队靠智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal, open AI agents echo the PC revolution, and open source prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化为 AI 正在民主化软件创造：个人化、开放的 AI 智能体如同个人电脑革命，开源可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI：AGI 不是单一事件，而是以运行在你自有基础设施上的智能体形式扩散；markdown 技能文件就是代码，个人上下文库即护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding lets one person do the work of thousands; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 同期在 a16z，他进一步说智能体式编程让一人可完成数千人的工作；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over bankers; rejection builds resilience; community and faith give meaning amid AGI questions.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，看重真正的建造者而非银行家，拒绝是韧性的考验，社区与信仰在 AGI 的终极追问中提供意义。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; shipped work distills 99 nos, not accumulation.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不；上线的作品是 99 次否定的蒸馏，而非不断堆叠。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关闭了一扇窥视机器意识的窗口；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理在辩证与矛盾中涌现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、重建工程纪律来重获信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立、类似初创公司的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves, requiring purpose-built silicon and new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要专用芯片与全新算力平台。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI as sea changes.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化判断：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的又一次海变。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and humility; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落到文化与领导力：Intel 需要文化变革、问责与谦逊，坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，这深化了他对算力格局的判断。

steinberger.en: Early on, agentic engineering is about empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterative conversation over heavy orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 早期他主张智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示与迭代对话取代冗长复杂的编排。

steinberger.en: Across talks he insists you should never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward, since model intelligence does not degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的一条主线：绝不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目变得更乱、更难导航。

steinberger.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, preferring agentic engineering for serious work, and stresses play and small projects as the way to learn.
steinberger.zh: 他反对把“氛围编程”当作贬义词，严肃开发应称智能体式工程，并强调玩耍与做小项目才是掌握智能体工作流的方式。

steinberger.en: Security stays the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全始终是首要问题：智能体必须沙箱化，绝不直接暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: His focus shifts from hands-on agent building to ecosystem and sustainability: open source runs anywhere, but compute and tokens—not model capability—are the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 他的关注点从亲手构建智能体转向生态与可持续性：开源随处可跑，但真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and 90% of enterprise use cases can be handled by many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；开源采用由成本驱动，90% 的企业用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; current usage is minuscule versus what it will be in 5-10 years.
arvindjain.zh: 我们正处于 AI 革命的极早期；当前使用量相比 5-10 年后的规模微不足道。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise AI tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业 AI 任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall significantly, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业头号关切；成本必须大幅下降，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本可忽略。

arvindjain.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 初创公司最大的挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lacking tenured employees' deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist, while open models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持开源并非加速主义，开放与有意放缓可以并存，长期看开源模型因成本与控制胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在强模型面前不足。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; the first autonomous attack reversed assumptions.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为放缓发展虽可取，但需国际合作与开放科学以防监管俘获；首次自主攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在长尾业务领域胜出。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件厂商难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 前先让 GPT-7 安全；应部署当前 AI 而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代；智能体编程已强于他，但这提升而非消灭该角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组权衡谱系——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可针对具体工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and workload-specific systems.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排与工作负载专用系统。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker with new tech, and leave individual fingerprints on products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调浏览器设计必须靠原型验证，设计师应追随好奇心、把玩新技术，并让个人印记留在产品上。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他透露 Claude Design 始于一人副项目，主张设计师用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: Rich context and prescriptive prompts are key; models lack taste, so ask for volume and let Claude handle mockups.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出丰富上下文与明确指令是关键；模型仍缺品味，因此应要求大量选项，让 Claude 承担 mockup 工作。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为工程变简单后，设计与创意成为差异化优势；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough, spend more time walking and thinking, since ideas are currency.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 时代宁可早得令人不适，也不追求打磨；应发布粗糙产品，多散步思考，因为好点子才是硬通货。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, not a data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间小心平衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling 提供了无限任务，预训练并未撞上数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值；而战略恰恰是 AI 能凭借合成数据与生成计划而擅长的。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 后训练始终是主观的艺术，依赖人类判断；评估创意写作与情商这类主观品质，需要多样化的基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, forcing continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体越来越擅长钻奖励的空子，迫使基准持续演进；用同一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成一种平庸的默认声音。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge; the field should build end-to-end storytelling engines, not just enterprise workflows.
karina.zh: 更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识；这个领域应打造端到端的叙事引擎，而不只是企业工作流。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利；CEO 必须吃自己的狗粮；通才将转型为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督；Codex 等图形界面将取代命令行；SaaS 随智能体增长；公司应部署一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大人的品味与技艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

danshipper.en: Human oversight and craft are essential; AI is a tool requiring direction, not a replacement for human meaning.
danshipper.zh: 始终不变的主线：人类监督与技艺至关重要；AI 是需要人类引导的工具，而非人类意义的替代品。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; use screenshots and design.md to encode style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则会沦为 AI 垃圾；用截图和 design.md 来编码风格。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写一切，但你必须在沟通中保持精确。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考中迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，并专注于一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；科学与金融等垂直领域将随之跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; the success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
