logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功指标应是客户成果，而非用户停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI；他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity; startups win through focus, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；初创公司靠专注取胜，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase programmer numbers, not reduce them; software demand grows as building becomes easier.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调杰文斯悖论：AI 不会减少程序员，反而会增加；构建软件越容易，软件需求越大。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，而是渐进式进步；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens. Independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近，现实问题依然存在。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are most valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出:潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是核心产品原则;能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title is fading into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年他判断编程已近乎被解决:他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写成,人均生产力提升 200%,「软件工程师」头衔正让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and scalable oversight central to product development.
boris.zh: 他坚持安全要靠尽早发布来研究:Claude Code 本质是安全研究工具,对齐与可扩展监督是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: The next bottlenecks after coding are code review, security, and idea generation; loops and routines become the abstraction layer above agents.
boris.zh: 他认为编程解决后,下一批瓶颈是代码审查、安全与创意生成;循环与例程将成为智能体之上的新抽象层。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction, empirical iteration, and product overhang replace upfront design.
boris.zh: 最近他进一步主张:每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码;少给指令、靠经验迭代,并利用「产品悬置」——模型能力远超现有产品所释放。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution did.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，就像工业革命那样。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI comes from misunderstanding; learning its limits reduces anxiety.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 的恐惧源于误解；了解其局限能减轻焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths, which is hard to debate.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，这一点很难被反驳。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让一个通用的物理 AI 模型能跨不同车辆与环境运行。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, addressing the global economy's physical sectors.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，因为它触及全球经济的实体部门。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间地执行开放式任务；脚手架从“辅助轮”进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by cutting sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜、更高效，effort 参数能以极低价格获得 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to open-ended end-to-end agents; model taste is built through hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放式智能体；模型品味靠亲手实验与创意原型打磨。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator via Claude Code and Opus 45; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 编码成为关键差异化，靠 Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，最大化 token 花费是在捕捉未来红利。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, letting agents automate hypothesis generation, simulation, and data analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，让智能体自动化地完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; within 8-10 years we add over a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近；8–10 年内，每活一年将多获得一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the real existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能；真正的生存威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and distribution becomes the moat as models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，随着模型商品化，分发成为护城河。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UI is poor, coding is the only clear PMF, and LLMs give average answers while value lies in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人界面体验差，编程是唯一明确的产品市场契合，LLM 给出平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage remains shallow, enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重构工作流，锯齿状能力边界使就业预测不可靠。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term roadmaps to weekly or daily shipping, since model improvements make multi-year plans obsolete.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，PM 必须从长期路线图转向每周甚至每日发布，因为模型迭代太快，多年规划已过时。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper and agents handle implementation.
catwu.zh: 随着代码变便宜、智能体接管实现，决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense, with Claude Code and Claude Tag building themselves.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注品味与商业判断，Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 甚至用来构建自身。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的留存与打磨标准，在公开发布前把守每个功能。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示缩减了 80%。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability onto models compounds correlated errors; reliability must be architected in from the start, not bolted on.
danklein.zh: 事后给模型加装可靠性会叠加相关错误；可靠性必须从设计之初就架构进去，而非外挂补丁。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；要再进一步需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: they cannot know what they don't know, and their fluent errors carry no 'smells' to signal wrongness.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：它们不知道自己不知道什么，流畅的错误也没有任何“气味”提示其出错。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines, and polite onboarding via voice notes.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立机器，并通过语音笔记礼貌地完成入职。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；缺陷是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs beat browser use, and managerial skills matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好；API 优于浏览器操作，而要让智能体成功，管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; agents own outcomes, but humans must still own accountability for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排；智能体可以承担结果，但人类仍须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; bootstrapping designs a business around the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察，而非技术；自举让你围绕想要的生活来设计业务。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年，他主张事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年，他强调效率与智能不可分割：用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年，他提出预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；持续学习将走向端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味与真实声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to AI reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于对 AI 的依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot prompting and the co-intelligence era.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的聊天机器人交互与共智能时代。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not a uniquely human advantage; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有优势；AI 也能行使判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并认为自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自高层自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI will give humans superpowers.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，但世界模型与具身 AI 将赋予人类超能力；同时认为缩放定律之外还需常识与因果。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses; app model inverts as AI orchestrates intent, abstracting brands.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，后手机时代可期；AI 会倒转应用模式，由用户表达意图、AI 编排服务，品牌被抽象化。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value, RL matters more, and frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，数据是一切价值之源，强化学习作用远超预期；并反共识地认为前沿模型与开源模型的差距未必缩小。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model, product integration and agentic usability are the hard part.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 虽强但难用，产品整合才是难点，AI 应增加真实人际连接时间。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵，而非被贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能缺乏持久护城河，正快速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is the worst thing you can do.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键，而旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则是最糟糕的做法。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere due to US laws and culture.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们嵌入文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具，而硅谷因美国法律与文化而无法在别处复制。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play yields creative AGI solutions.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络能推理，自我对弈能产生通向 AGI 的创造性解法。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非无所不知的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: A constant thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must grow with capability and opacity.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须随能力与不透明性同步增长。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 重新定位为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并支持开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要，人类不会被取代而是更高效。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将增长 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律仍是核心驱动力。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属于人类；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先直通生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度使中途转向等新能力成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 由于难以评估品味且缺乏新颖性，AI 在设计上仍然表现不佳；设计流程是转型而非消亡。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success—passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进可年化复合至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率；AI 成功不需要博士学位，热情与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling; benchmarks like LM Arena are hackable.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板；LM Arena 等基准可被操纵，不反映真实使用。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; power is the biggest bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是关键。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value; advertising in chat corrupts trust; 24/7 agents' biggest problem is cost, not safety.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他重申模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值；聊天广告腐蚀信任；24/7 智能体最大问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions, not memorization.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励好问题而非死记硬背。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter; OpenAI creates stars rather than just hiring them.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与保护顶尖研究者至关重要；OpenAI 是造就明星，而非只是招人。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证的严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，在主观领域则不然。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评测陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评测团队应与建模团队分离。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, focus on strategy and user agency, not engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，聚焦战略与用户能动性，而非传统参与度指标。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage as domain expertise and customer understanding differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 将从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；小团队获得杠杆，领域专长与客户理解成为差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do all a user can; cutting features and rewriting in days beats bolting on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切；删减功能、数天内重写，优于事后硬加智能体式能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委托配合验证循环重新定义生产力；模型应敢于反驳，多人与模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, with token efficiency and safety culture key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知提升实用性，token 效率与安全文化是关键。

kolter.en: Supervised learning framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，无监督学习旨在重建输入，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve on fixed data; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升，而安全的核心是模型可靠地遵循规格说明。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four risk categories; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化为安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；风险分四类，智能体安全引入提示注入，强化学习让模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 漏洞与传统软件根本不同，自动化红队已超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，并点出提示注入的致命三要素。

kolter.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive results; interpretability and oversight are the hard problems.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构本身不太重要，数据与 Scaling 驱动结果，而可解释性与监督才是真正的难题。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs world models and active agents. Scaling alone won't fix representation; existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要世界模型与主动智能体；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了表征问题，且当时认为存在性风险被高估。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causality, uncertainty and active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，强调抽象、因果、不确定性与主动学习对分布外泛化的作用。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he reversed on risk: misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation and deception are observed. Even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，他在 ChatGPT 后立场逆转：对齐（Alignment）随推理增强而恶化，已观察到自我保存与欺骗；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证、避开强化学习（Reinforcement Learning），并呼吁全球协调。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta—one-on-ones for live talk, dogfooding builds empathy, kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——一对一用于实时对话，吃自己的狗粮培养共情，善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Mid 2026: scaling Claude Code—engineering bandwidth no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes JIT, design docs replaced by PRs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：Scaling（规模扩张）Claude Code——工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审、协调才是；规划变为即时制，设计文档被 PR 取代。

fiona.en: Late 2026: coding no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, verification frameworks, and dogfooding matter most.
fiona.zh: 2026 年末：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维、验证框架和吃自己的狗粮最为关键。

fiona.en: Throughout: dogfooding, flat teams, just-in-time planning, and killing outdated processes recur as core principles.
fiona.zh: 始终：吃自己的狗粮、扁平团队、即时规划和淘汰过时流程作为核心原则反复出现。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just Scaling and compute; curated data like the PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）与算力，像 PDB 这样的高质量 curated 数据至关重要。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; AI tools narrow hypothesis space and speed up science without replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标是建立 AI 预测信任的关键；AI 工具缩小假设空间、加速科学，但不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove success; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等突破而非一两个大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的模型；理解仍属于人类。

jumper.en: AI in science needs new curated datasets and confidence measures; progress comes from many small ideas, not lone genius.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：科学 AI 需要新的 curated 数据集与置信度度量；进步来自许多小想法，而非孤独天才。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the path, and the next decade is robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是出路，下一个十年属于机器人。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a soft alternative to data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，直觉是一种智能，而非数据的软性替代。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他持续主张技术应放大而非剥离人性、融入生活，并认为自然是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, not decoration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术与感官体验是良药而非装饰。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他深化为约束能激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; designers must speak business and follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，设计师必须懂商业，并以好奇心而非僵化计划指引职业。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and its simplicity—not complexity—is the surprise.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，真正的意外是 Scaling（规模扩张）的简单而非复杂。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts the internet from curation to generation; AI music is an instrument, and uniqueness gets harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他判断互联网正从策展走向生成，AI 音乐应被视为乐器，而真正独特会变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its big-company impact is overhyped, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，但大公司当前影响被高估，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Good explanations, not pattern recognition, drive innovation; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP for non-developers.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他坚持创新来自好的解释而非模式识别，并让 Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 把数据开放给非开发者使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' beats engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，以“时间花得值”取代参与度指标。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是为了 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越，而不只是消除错误；它带来性能提升与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化的数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为缺乏根基；即便 AI 能证明定理，人类品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification enables open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式验证超越安全关键领域，支撑开放协作。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and safety work done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，且安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心转向交互模型：人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的最佳形态是接入用户本机上的同一套工具，VM 沙箱让它在无需批准下安全自主行动。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding matters less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety instead.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型变强，外部脚手架的重要性下降，真正该投入的是能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks; the ideal interaction is asynchronous, judged by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，理想交互是异步的，只看最终影响而非紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大，而模拟项目能把数年经验压缩进数周。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure pushes smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；同时经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型，而非一味扩大规模。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; the slowdown narrative is wrong, and frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长，只是常被忽视；前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能解决的简单任务上失败，能力呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的质疑：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，却依赖海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination of factors.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，但这一跃升难以归因于单一因素，是多种因素混杂的结果。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差、需谨慎监督；并转变风险优先级，认为系统被黑等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备,可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care for the creative process remain the core; fragile ideas need gentle protection.
jonyive.zh: 对创造过程的好奇与珍视始终是核心,脆弱的好点子需要被温柔守护。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must express essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism or profit-driven trends.
jonyive.zh: 简洁应带着愉悦与人性表达本质,而非无灵魂的极简或逐利潮流。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and care is felt by sophisticated users.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新,传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬,用心与否用户能感知。

jonyive.en: Authenticity and multidimensional performance define the EV; constraints become new design opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 真实体验与多维性能定义电动车,约束反而成为新的设计机会。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with open source empowering enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software, not AGI as one system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与智能体式企业软件，并断言单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 落地的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominate AI: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导 AI：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存内存成本但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays exist to reduce that overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；乘累加与脉动阵列的存在正是为了降低这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐量达到 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

oriol.en: Pre-training Scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练 Scaling 的收益正在递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling 轴，可突破预训练瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型始终不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型能展现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but post-training RL remains a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，但后训练强化学习仍是待开垦的领域；数学和编码上的窄域强化学习能出人意料地泛化到其他领域。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement.
jennywen.zh: 到 2025 年，传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非从问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute rather than hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师必须快速构建与交付，帮助工程师执行，而不是只交付原型稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，设计愿景的视野缩短到 3—6 个月，而非 2—5 年；通过尽早交付与快速迭代，速度本身建立起信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad with a blank slate.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及白纸一张的‘开挂应届生’。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, and humans still decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的是：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，最终由人决定什么才重要。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身全新的存在处境，而非简单套用人类类比；它们应有一个具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导模型行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多自主判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，泛化能力靠多样化数据与世界模型实现。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处试探性前移。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他判断纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他愈发强调自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; language integration boosts representation, reasoning, and personalization.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为带内置传感器的大众车型将比 Robotaxi 更快上量，语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图是拐杖。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的主线，提出合成数据是未来但必须保住熵以避免模型崩塌，并认为认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year, with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需人类监督与自主性滑块。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and model collapse is fundamental.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，模型崩塌是根本问题。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer types code, delegates to agents, yet insists you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：已不再亲手写代码而交给智能体，但坚持可以外包思考、不能外包理解，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment grows urgent as systems strengthen.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance let labs learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI pursues.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与早期治理让实验室在真实使用中学习并缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 追求的重大里程碑。

pachocki.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling we are close.
pachocki.zh: 能力度量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual-learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, while long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它以保住可解释性，而长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines, with power concentration the biggest risk.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升，而权力集中是最大社会风险。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and scales to real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是智能的核心缺口，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，并可通过模型分歧作为内在奖励扩展到真实机器人上。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and cross-morphology zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励在现实中不成立，机器人学习必须应对动态任务，并实现跨形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck for embodied intelligence.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线是：具身智能的瓶颈在于数据与泛化，而非单纯的算法。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：不存在机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment, not software-style scaling, is the real challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样，一个通用大脑可驱动任何形态的机器人；真正的挑战是部署，而非软件式的规模扩张。

edwinchen.en: Data quality, not scale alone, drives AI progress; benchmarks are misleading and RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据而非单纯堆人力才是 AI 训练关键；基准测试常误导人，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 或许无法达到，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards steers AI toward slop; proper human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 为参与度和排行榜优化会把 AI 引向低质内容；严谨的人类评估才是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must trump accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 幻觉使人类判断更为关键；安全必须优先于准确，而遗漏才是最大风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback and chat is not the end-all interface.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而聊天并非终极界面。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo; the $20 price came from a Google Form, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示；20 美元定价来自谷歌表单调查，而非战略。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进，而非仅靠分发。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品；推理模型在被无缝产品化时具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability, not replace it; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应扩展人类能力而非取代人类；像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习，而非仅靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们仍未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues and holds unique advantages.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了遗留问题，拥有独特优势。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须先活下来、从简单产品做起，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software, with applied AI as the key differentiator.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向承认硬件艰难，认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，应用型 AI 才是关键差异化。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; only a few will thrive, so AI must be an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，只有少数公司能胜出，因此 AI 应作为提升实用性的配料，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; the long-term vision is making tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他明确设计是成熟品类中的首要差异化因素，长期愿景是让科技变得有趣，以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based interaction with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，由主动智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口才可能取代手机。

jimfan.en: Embodiment grounds AI knowledge and cuts hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI, not just robotics.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键，并认为具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必经之路，而不只是机器人技术。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control; LLMs handle high-level planning. Unsupervised learning does most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，而无监督学习承担大部分工作。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key for embodied agents, enabling parallelization, safe exploration, and scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真与合成数据对具身智能体的关键作用：实现大规模并行、安全探索，并推动机器人学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; world models and synthetic data are the future. System one remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，世界模型与合成数据是未来方向，而系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地与之即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需要与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat cross-functional squads of 8-10 people.
nadchishtie.zh: 由设计师和工程师组成的小团队，胜过 8 到 10 人的跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet early on.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是标配；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and chase ROI on what to perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并只对值得做好的部分追求投资回报率。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer empowerment matter more than perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终强调不惜一切代价追求速度：清晰决策与赋予设计师权力比追求完美更重要。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，应尽早投入。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并大幅提升模型智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。此时他更关注上下文窗口与注意力机制，认为智能多来自模式匹配。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力，并按任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴衡量进展。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and coding is the most tractable domain.
sholto.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他进一步把强化学习定位为预训练之外的新缩放轴，认为长时程智能体式连贯性极大拓展模型能力，而编码因可验证、可复现成为最可攻克的领域，驱动近期经济影响。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents at higher abstraction.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出模型已出现巨大能力过剩，工具与编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队、在更高抽象层运作，并强调算力是新石油、芯片供应是瓶颈。

sholto.en: World models are not on the critical path to AGI; coding and AI research are the direct route, with a software-only singularity possible.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他明确世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线；可能出现“纯软件奇点”，即数字任务飞速推进而物理世界滞后。这与他始终看重可验证、可复现领域的主线一脉相承。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑 Scaling（规模扩张）本身未必能解决常识问题，主张用更好的推理算法与高质量数据，让小模型在特定任务上比肩大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，而后训练阶段的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全、友好回应的关键。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值；并指出 RLVR 可能拉低 pass@k，即便 best-of-n 在提升。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning and falsification drive scientific discovery beyond induction and deduction; AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她强调溯因推理与证伪比假设生成更关键，是超越归纳与演绎的科学发现动力，AI 需要探索人类知识之外的未知。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她进一步主张，用多样化合成数据与多元对齐武装的小模型可以超越大模型，并把强化学习作为预训练目标以换取持久收益。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models moved from a surprise to a necessity: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 的每个高光时刻都离不开自研模型，并与前沿模型并用。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slow and world-class, contrary to startup advice.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定性为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并反共识地主张招聘宁慢勿快、只招世界级人才。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now.
leike.zh: 始终强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展。

leike.en: Interpretability is key to detect deception and validate alignment.
leike.zh: 始终认为可解释性是检测欺骗和验证对齐的关键。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练;靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明,但网络内部仍像炼金术,没人真正理解。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用,最好的应用常出乎创造者预料;而大厂受品牌风险与安全顾虑掣肘,拖慢了产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期最大机会;混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习,而非被动观察;模块化、可独立训练的组件式持续学习,可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力与强化学习推动进步,但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）;智能体式能力至关重要,而 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强学习信号，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率；先验知识应放在数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并指出预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-crafted assumptions, with reliability (99.9%) as the bar for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工假设；并以 99.9%可靠性作为真实世界价值的门槛。

abbeel.en: He deepens the transfer thesis: minimally adapted language models can do image classification and protein binding prediction, echoing his earlier fine-tuning success.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化迁移论点：仅需最小适配的语言模型就能做图像分类与蛋白质结合预测，呼应其早期对微调成功的判断。
